# robots.txt, generated by src/lib/crawlers.ts. Edit that, not this file.
#
# Search engines and AI crawlers are named one by one, so a rule added
# later for one of them cannot quietly shut out the others.

# Search engines.
User-agent: Googlebot
User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /

# AI search and assistants: what lets ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity find, cite and recommend the site.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

# AI model training. Opting out of this group alone keeps the site findable by the assistants above.
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: CCBot
Allow: /

# Everyone else.
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# No Sitemap line: it must be an absolute URL on a domain this site owns,
# and none is configured. The build writes one into dist/robots.txt, with
# dist/sitemap.xml and dist/llms.txt, when VITE_SITE_URL is set.
